intro_prepare: Hello, and welcome to your fitting. Before we start: wear something close-fitting, and tie long hair up if you can. Stand the phone upright at about waist height, somewhere with a little space around you. You'll stand about two metres away. Tap okay when you're ready.
intro_pose: Lovely. When we begin, face the phone with your hands empty and your arms straight, a little away from your sides, like an upside-down V. Then I'll ask you to turn to your left, a little at a time, and to hold still at each step while I take a picture. There are eight steps in all, and I'll tell you each time when to turn and when to hold.
setup: Right, let's begin. Walk about two metres back and face the phone. Hands empty, arms straight and a little out to the sides.
good: That's perfect. Hold still, just like that, while I take the first picture.
stop_1: Now turn a little to your left, about an eighth of the way round, and hold still.
stop_2: Lovely. A little more to your left, until your side faces the phone. And hold.
stop_3: And a little more. Hold it there.
stop_4: Keep going, until your back is to the phone. And hold still.
stop_5: Lovely. A little more to your left, and hold.
stop_6: Now your other side faces the phone. Hold still.
stop_7: Last one. A little more, and hold.
hold: Please hold still for a moment while I take the picture.
done: And that's it. You're all done. Thank you so much for your patience. You can come back to the phone now.
step_back: Please take one small step back.
come_closer: Please take one step closer to the phone.
whole_body: I need to see all of you, from your head to your feet. Please take one step back.
not_seen: I can't see you yet. Please stand in front of the phone, about two metres away.
arms_up: Please lift your arms a little away from your body, like an upside-down V, and keep them there.
arms_down: Please lower your arms a little, to about halfway between your sides and your shoulders.
stay_centre: Please move back to the middle of the picture, then hold still.
